title: SING PRAISES TO GOD
IT IS GOOD AND PLEASANT
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving

scenes.a: Right now, in this quiet kitchen after a long day, lift your heart in praise.
Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
scenes.sub: IT IS GOOD TO SING PRAISES

scenes.a: Father, we thank You for Your endless grace that restores our weary souls.
Even when our spirit feels tired, declaring Your goodness brings light into the dark places.
Singing to You is pleasant, beautiful, and right. We offer You our simple gratitude for every unseen mercy You have provided.
May praise constantly overflow from this heart today. Subscribe to join our garden of praise.
